page.layout: One printed page: running head "EMBLEMA" at top with page number at top left; a title heading in capitals with italic continuation below; a large engraving (emblem with heart, wings, hands, book, fruit, clouds); a four-line italic verse below the engraving; catchword "Cor" at lower right.

main_text.head: LVCET PER ÆRVMNAS fidês.
main_text.l: Per varios casus, per mille pericula rerum
Turbida iucundum spero post nubila Phæbum,
Dum præeat Verbum lampada opemq; tuum.

page.notes: The engraving shows a flaming heart with wings, two crossed nails, two hands clasping above a hanging book, a fruit cluster at the base, and clouds at the sides; it is described, not transcribed. The verse is set in italic with long s rendered as plain s; "Mirificas sanctos" and "Sanctos" have a ligature-like shape in the print and "sanctos" is read with some doubt. The running head is a word in small capitals, the title "LVCET PER ÆRVMNAS" in capitals with "fides." set below in italic.
